frameworks.name: Miles
frameworks.scope: Generic Python package snapshot from the historical wheel; unrelated optional extensions with unverified public origin are excluded as recorded in environment/privacy_exclusions.json; private experiment entrypoints excluded.

frameworks.name: Megatron-Core
frameworks.scope: Complete generic package snapshot exported from the inspected image tag; affected traceback statements match. Mutable image tag prevents asserting a byte-identical historical image.

historical_evidence.published_metric_values: Observed standard numerical training metrics only; retained values unchanged; private scoring fields omitted.

limitations: The API archive covers selected training pods, not every external service file or tracker binary.
Historical evidence, historical corrected smoke (where present), inspected source and new reduced validation are distinct runs.
The reduced public model/data/reward do not reproduce the private training curve or establish benchmark gains.

privacy_boundary.log_policy: No source record positions are removed. Explicit redaction markers replace unpublished context. Only observed standard metrics, configuration and structural framework events are retained.
omitted: private prompt content and generation implementation
private reward model design, rubrics, dimensions and payloads
private task text, trajectories, trained model/optimizer/checkpoint payloads
original user paths, internal service addresses, pod names and job identifiers
privacy_boundary.public_replacement: Randomly initialized small real Megatron GPTModel/MTP1 with public random tokens; actual forward/backward/AdamW and small checkpoint roundtrip in the corrected control.

source_kind: Affected generic framework source, explicit optional-extension exclusions, archived training-pod logs, and separately identified reduced real-framework validation

source_modifications.derived_assets: The public tiny model is initialized by scripts during prepare/execution; generated weights and new checkpoints are not part of the submitted task.
source_modifications.label_replacements: Project identifiers and local paths are anonymized; per-source identities are recorded in the source provenance inventory.
source_modifications.optional_extension_exclusions: environment/privacy_exclusions.json records omitted implementation, final source identities and checks preserving standard GRPO.
source_modifications.private_boundary: The default workspace keeps the baseline hook without the postprocessing repair; the reference hook is held outside the visible workspace.
